### I help clinical teams work with greater efficiency — through automated workflows and interactive visualizations built with R, Shiny, Quarto, and D3.js.


:::{#hero-heading}

With over a decade of experience in clinical trial programming across CRO and pharmaceutical environments, I specialize in SAS programming, CDISC standards, and regulatory delivery across Phase I–III studies.

Building on this foundation, I use R, Python, Shiny, Quarto, and D3.js to improve clinical data review, automate repetitive workflows, and make complex clinical data easier to understand.

Explore my work below, or connect with me on LinkedIn to exchange ideas about clinical programming, data quality, and workflow innovation.

## Current Focus

- Clinical Data Visualization
- Validation Strategy
- Modular Workflow Design

## Performance Summary

Clinical Research Organization | Pharmaceutical Company | Statistical Programming

- 12 years of clinical trial programming experience with deep expertise in SDTM, ADaM, and regulatory submission.

- Led an 18-member team to complete COVID-19 Phase III programming within 3 months; results published in NEJM.

- Co-led a regulatory-requested RWE study during the COVID-19 program; standardized unstructured hospital RWD through a complete SDTM, ADaM, and TLF pipeline in alignment with regulatory data governance requirements.

- Skilled at cross-functional collaboration, providing medical-monitor support and creating publication-ready output.

- Developed automation tools including an aCRF mapping system and review validation tools, boosting efficiency by 60%.

- Presented at R/Pharma 2024 and ShinyConf 2025, demonstrating advanced R Shiny proficiency.

- Delivered two presentations at useR! 2026 in Warsaw: a Lightning Talk, "Reproducible Clinical Data Review: A Modular R and Quarto Workflow for Transparent Reporting," and a Poster, "Patient Timeline Visualization: Presenting Individual and Population-Level Clinical Trial Journeys with R and D3.js."

- Promoted at three consecutive companies (PAREXEL, Athenex, Junshi), advancing from Programmer to Statistical Programming Manager.

## Therapeutic Area

Oncology, Cardiovascular, Immunology, Dermatology, Endocrinology, Nephrology, and more — across 12+ years of clinical trial programming.
